problem: A container replacement return must not hide writes to a borrowed primitive builtin input. Native descriptor calls, special methods, identity helpers and eager evaluation must not bypass that contract.
extensions: Eager synchronous generator consumption by native collection constructors
Body-preserving staticmethod/classmethod/final markers in plain class namespaces
Literal collection/comparison reachability and comparison-chain short circuiting
Unbound native mutation descriptors and explicit mutation special methods
Boolean value selections with one proven borrowed owner
remediation: Copy before writing, or expose a separate command returning None. The provisioning helper found by this qualification now returns None while its caller derives the immutable command arguments from inputs. No automatic copying or deletion is offered.
scopeLimits: Source-resolved contracts only; application modules, annotations and truth methods are never executed.
Primitive direct builtin mutable inputs, direct builtin container outputs, bounded aliases/branches and supported eager expressions.
Preserve native resource, registration, synchronization, process, filesystem and transaction command/result protocols.
Opaque types, arbitrary I/O, nested descendants, receiver state, custom decorators, loops and try/context-manager orchestration remain outside general purity enforcement.

fullVerification.note: Local private-reference scan delegates to trusted exact-revision CI; that CI remains required before merge.

classification.qualificationLimit: Finite inspected findings are not an empirical fleet precision estimate. Corpus pins were verified without refresh; identities and raw findings remain private.

campaign.countingPolicy: Distinct demonstrated defects, maintained-owner reviews, native protocol boundaries and qualification/remediation decisions. Repeated tests, generated vectors and cosmetic variants are not passes.

performance.method: Separate process per corpus and mode; first invocation cold, then median of three fresh-session warm invocations; baseline is all shipped Python rules except the candidate, combined adds the candidate.
performance.limitations: Bounded 25-file self corpus; host contention and run-to-run variance limit generalization. No fleet speedup claim.
